title: SARS-CoV-2 Detection with ApharSeq
author: Daphna Strauss
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bkdcks2w
materials: Air dry to remove traces of ethanol 00:04:00
Magnetzie and transfer 21 µl to new tube
Demultiplex pool indices with the bcl2fastq script (Illumina)

steps.title: Prepare poly dT beads
steps.instruction: Prepare poly dT beads for the sample.

substeps.instruction: Use 5 µl poly dT beads per sample
Wash beads twice in binding buffer: resuspend in binding buffer, magnetize, and remove buffer
Resuspend beads in 320 µl binding buffer

steps.title: Hybridize viral sample to beads
steps.instruction: Hybridize the inactivated viral sample to the prepared beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 320 µl inactivated viral sample to 320 µl beads in binding buffer
Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature while mixing
Magnetize and remove supernatant

steps.title: Anneal primers
steps.instruction: Anneal RT primers to the captured RNA.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 50 µl of a 1:1 mix of binding buffer and 10 µM RT primer(s)
Heat sample to 72 °C for 2 minutes, then incubate on ice for at least 2 minutes
Incubate samples for 10 minutes at room temperature, mixing by rotating or pipetting every 5 minutes
Magnetize beads and discard supernatant

steps.title: Wash and pool samples
steps.instruction: Wash the beads and pool the samples together.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 450 µl wash buffer A
Magnetize and remove 380 µl
Resuspend beads in the remaining 70 µl and pool samples
Wash beads twice in wash buffer B: resuspend in 500 µl buffer B, magnetize, and carefully remove buffer
Optional: Pool can be stored in RNA later at 4 °C for a week; if stored, wash twice in Wash buffer B before proceeding to reverse transcription

steps.title: Perform reverse transcription
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA from the pooled RNA.

substeps.instruction: Magnetize PCR tube and wash pooled beads in 1x RT buffer: resuspend in 50 µl 1x RT buffer, magnetize, and remove buffer
Resuspend in 50 µl RT reaction mix
Incubate for 15 minutes at 25 °C, then 45 minutes at 42 °C, and 15 minutes at 70 °C
Note: A standard RT-PCR kit (PrimeScript™ One Step RT-PCR) can be used, executing the RT part first before adding PCR primers

steps.title: Elute cDNA
steps.instruction: Release the cDNA from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the beads for 2 minutes at 98 °C
Magnetize and immediately transfer the supernatant to a new tube

steps.title: Clean up cDNA via 2x SPRI
steps.instruction: Purify the eluted cDNA using SPRI beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µl SPRI beads and mix well
Incubate for 4 minutes
Magnetize for 4 minutes and remove supernatant
Wash twice with 70% ethanol: add 100 µl 70% ethanol, incubate for 30 seconds, and remove ethanol without disturbing beads
Air dry for 4 minutes to remove traces of ethanol
Resuspend in 23 µl 10 mM Tris 8.0
Incubate for 2 minutes
Magnetize and transfer 21 µl to a new tube
Add to each sample pool: 25 µl Kapa RM, 2 µl 10 µM PCR-primer F, and 2 µl 10 µM PCR-primer R
Run PCR program: 98°C for 3 minutes; 30 cycles of {95°C for 20sec, 59°C for 15sec, 72°C for 50sec}; final extension at 72°C for 10 min; hold at 10°C

steps.title: Clean up library via 1x SPRI
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR product using SPRI beads.

substeps.instruction: Perform SPRI cleanup following the same procedure as the 2x SPRI step
Elute in 15 µl 10 mM Tris 8.0

steps.title: Assess library
steps.instruction: Verify the quality and quantity of the library.

substeps.instruction: Determine library concentration (e.g., by Qubit) and size (by tape/gel)
If necessary, clean primer dimers by running on a gel or by 1x SPRI

steps.title: Sequence library
steps.instruction: Sequence the library on an Illumina machine.

substeps.instruction: Assign 5 million reads per 100 sample pool
Assign at least 20 cycles to R1 (barcode + UMI) and either an additional 30 cycles to R1 or 30 cycles to R2

steps.title: Analyze data
steps.instruction: Process the sequencing data to report unique molecules.

substeps.instruction: Demultiplex pool indices with the bcl2fastq script (Illumina)
Process each fastq file independently
Split reads based on RT primer target (E/N1/ActB) and barcode (R1:4-8 + R1:13-17, inclusive)
Filter reads that do not exhibit their expected sequence (e.g., read with E primer should have the E sequence immediately after the primer)
Collect UMI sequence per read (R1:1-4 + R1:9-12 + R1:18-19)
Cluster UMI sequences (e.g., by hamming distance and/or with UMI-tools)
Report unique molecules per target/sample
Wash with 500 µl PK buffer
Resuspend in 500 µl PK mix (0.4mg/ml PK in PK buffer)
Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature while rotating
Magnetize and wash three times in 1ml wash buffer A
Magnetize and wash twice in 1ml wash buffer B
Note: Incubation time at RT or 37C may need calibration
